summary: Build brand safety controls, approval workflows, and AI content governance skills in this practical 5-day course. Enquire now.
lede: Generative AI content governance sets review, prompt and brand-safety controls for teams publishing AI-assisted content. This training is for marketing, communications, editorial and creative operations professionals who need repeatable approval and escalation processes. You’ll learn to assess content risks, create approved prompt libraries and brand-safety scorecards, and design editorial workflows for checking claims, handling disclosures and escalating concerns such as inaccurate or copyrighted material.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who oversee AI-assisted content production, brand consistency, editorial quality, and approval workflows across marketing, communications, and creative operations.
audience: Copywriter using approved prompts and checklists
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience with content planning, brand messaging, editorial review, digital marketing, or communications workflows. A basic understanding of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI writing assistants is helpful, along with familiarity with brand guidelines, approval processes, and content QA practices. No coding is required for completion, and advanced governance topics will be taught at an operational application level rather than a technical engineering level.
